features.title: Master of the dead
features.text: Necromancers study occult magic to command the dead. They prepare spells of life and death and raise fragile undead thralls.

features.title: Thralls
features.text: Place thralls to help allies flank, then destroy them to fuel spells. Creatures can pass through them, and they act only through necromancer abilities.
